mapper.sql:
SELECT NULL AS PN
UNION SELECT DISTINCT ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 AS PN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ITMMASTER LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ECCSTA ECCSTA ON ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 = ECCSTA.ITMREF_0 WHERE ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 = #{PN} OR ( ECCSTA.ITMREF_0 + '_' + ECCSTA.ECCVALMAJ_0 = #{PN} )
UNION SELECT ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 AS PN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ITMMASTER WHERE LEFT (ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0, 4) = 'PNOG' AND ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 LIKE '%' + #{PN} + '%'
UNION SELECT ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 AS PN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ITMMASTER WHERE LEFT (ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0, 4) = 'PNOG' AND ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 LIKE '%' + #{PN} + '%'
UNION SELECT TRIM(ITMBPS.ITMREFBPS_0) AS PN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPS ITMBPS WHERE TRIM(ITMBPS.ITMREF_0) = #{PN} UNION SELECT ITMBPS.ITMREF_0 AS PN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPS ITMBPS WHERE TRIM(ITMBPS.ITMREFBPS_0) = #{PN} UNION SELECT ITMBPC.ITMREF_0 AS PN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPC ITMBPC WHERE TRIM(ITMBPC.ITMREFBPC_0) = #{PN} UNION SELECT TRIM(ITMBPC.ITMREFBPC_0) AS PN FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPC ITMBPC WHERE TRIM(ITMBPC.ITMREF_0) = #{PN}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 AS PNROOT, ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 AS PN, ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 ) + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 ) AS Description FROM EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ITMMASTER WHERE ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 LIKE #{PN} ORDER BY ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 ASC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

-- Suppliers PN SELECT BPARTNER.BPRNUM_0 AS BPCode, BPARTNER.BPRSHO_0 AS BPName, ITMREFBPS_0 AS OptionPN, IIF ( ITMDESBPS_0 != '', ITMDESBPS_0, ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 ) + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 ) ) AS Description FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPS ITMBPS LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.BPARTNER ON ITMBPS.BPSNUM_0 = BPARTNER.BPRNUM_0 LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ON ITMBPS.ITMREF_0 = ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 WHERE ITMBPS.ITMREF_0 = #{PN} AND ITMBPS.ITMREF_0 != ITMBPS.ITMREFBPS_0 -- Suppliers PN2 UNION SELECT '00000' AS BPCode, 'DEDIENNE' AS BPName, ITMREFBPS_0 AS OptionPN, IIF ( ITMDESBPS_0 != '', ITMDESBPS_0, ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 ) + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 ) ) AS Description FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPS ITMBPS LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ON ITMBPS.ITMREF_0 = ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 WHERE TRIM(ITMBPS.ITMREFBPS_0) = #{PN} AND ITMBPS.ITMREF_0 != ITMBPS.ITMREFBPS_0 -- Customer PN UNION SELECT BPARTNER.BPRNUM_0 AS BPCode, BPARTNER.BPRSHO_0 AS BPName, ITMREFBPC_0 AS OptionPN, IIF ( ITMDESBPC_0 != '', ITMDESBPC_0, ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 ) + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 ) ) AS Description FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPC ITMBPC LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.BPARTNER ON ITMBPC.BPCNUM_0 = BPARTNER.BPRNUM_0 LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ON ITMBPC.ITMREF_0 = ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 WHERE ITMBPC.ITMREF_0 = #{PN} AND ITMBPC.ITMREF_0 != ITMBPC.ITMREFBPC_0 -- Customer PN2 UNION SELECT '00000' AS BPCode, 'DEDIENNE' AS BPName, ITMREFBPC_0 AS OptionPN, IIF ( ITMDESBPC_0 != '', ITMDESBPC_0, ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 ) + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 ) ) AS Description FROM EXPLOIT.ITMBPC ITMBPC LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ON ITMBPC.ITMREF_0 = ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 WHERE TRIM(ITMBPC.ITMREFBPC_0) = #{PN} AND ITMBPC.ITMREF_0 != ITMBPC.ITMREFBPC_0
UNION SELECT '00000' AS BPCode, 'DEDIENNE' AS BPName, ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 AS OptionPN, ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 ) + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 ) AS Description FROM EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ITMMASTER WHERE LEFT (ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0, 4) = 'PNOG' AND ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 LIKE '%' + #{PN} + '%'
UNION SELECT '00000' AS BPCode, 'DEDIENNE' AS BPName, ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 AS OptionPN, ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 ) + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 ) AS Description FROM EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ITMMASTER WHERE LEFT (ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0, 4) = 'PNOG' AND ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 LIKE '%' + #{PN} + '%'

WITH TPN AS ( ), T0 AS ( SELECT ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 AS PNROOT, IIF ( ITMMASTER.ECCFLG_0 = 2, ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 + '_' + ECCSTA.ECCVALMAJ_0, ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 ) AS PN, ITMMASTER.TSICOD_0 AS Cat, ECCSTA.ECCVALMAJ_0 AS Version, ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 ) + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 ) AS Description, ITMMASTER.YITM_COMSTA_0 AS Comment, IIF (ECCSTA.EXNFLG_0 = 2, 5, ITMMASTER.ITMSTA_0) AS Status, ITMMASTER.CREDAT_0 AS CreateDate FROM TPN INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER ON TPN.PN = ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ECCSTA ECCSTA ON ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 = ECCSTA.ITMREF_0 ) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY T0.Version DESC ) AS ID, T0.PNROOT, T0.PN, T0.Cat, T0.Version, T0.Description, T0.Comment, T0.Status, T0.CreateDate FROM T0

SELECT YITMINDUS.YCHKDWG_0 checkDrawing, APLSTD.LANMES_0 typo, YITMINDUS.YCOMPLEX_0 complex, YITMINDUS.YWAROUT_0 warnManufTool, YITMINDUS.YWARCE_0 warnCE, YITMINDUS.YWAREXTRA_0 warnExtraSize, YITMINDUS.YWARCAST_0 warnCasters, YITMINDUS.YWARLIFT_0 warnLifting, YITMINDUS.YCOMCOM_0 isComponents, YITMINDUS.YMATALU_0 rawAluminum, YITMINDUS.YMATSTL_0 rawSteel, YITMINDUS.YMATPLA_0 rawPlastic, YITMINDUS.YMATVAR_0 rawVariousMaterial, YITMINDUS.YMATSPE_0 rawSpecific, YITMINDUS.YTTHHTRT_0 heatTreatment, YITMINDUS.YMACGEA_0 machineGrinding, YITMINDUS.YMACGRI_0 machineGear, YITMINDUS.YTTSSTD_0 ttsStand, YITMINDUS.YTTSSPE_0 ttsSpecific, YITMINDUS.YTTSPAI_0 ttsPainting, YITMINDUS.YTTSPLC_0 ttsPlastic, YITMINDUS.YPCKSPB_0 specialPackingBox, YITMINDUS.YCONLOT_0 testLoad, YITMINDUS.YCONHYD_0 testHydraulic, YITMINDUS.YCONBAT_0 testBalancing, YITMINDUS.YCONVAR_0 testVarious, YITMINDUS.YCONCAL_0 controlCalibration, YITMINDUS.YCONSPE_0 controlSpecific, YITMINDUS.YCONGEO_0 control3D FROM EXPLOIT.YITMINDUS YITMINDUS LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.APLSTD APLSTD ON APLSTD.LAN_0 = 'ENG' AND LANCHP_0 = '6557' AND APLSTD.LANNUM_0 = YITMINDUS.YFAMPN_0 WHERE ITMREF_0 = #{PN}
SELECT TOP 1 ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 FROM ITMMASTER WHERE ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 = #{PN}

SELECT IIF ( ITMMASTER.ECCFLG_0 = 2, ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 + '_' + ECCSTA.ECCVALMAJ_0, ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 ) AS PN, ITMMASTER.ITMDES1_0 + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES2_0 ) + IIF ( ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 = '', '', ' ' + ITMMASTER.ITMDES3_0 ) AS Description, IIF ( ECCSTA.EXNFLG_0 = 2, 'Obsolete', ( CASE WHEN ITMMASTER.ITMSTA_0 = 1 THEN 'Active' WHEN ITMMASTER.ITMSTA_0 = 2 THEN 'InDevelopment' WHEN ITMMASTER.ITMSTA_0 = 3 THEN 'OnShortage' WHEN ITMMASTER.ITMSTA_0 = 4 THEN 'NotRenewed' WHEN ITMMASTER.ITMSTA_0 = 5 THEN 'Obsolete' WHEN ITMMASTER.ITMSTA_0 = 6 THEN 'NotUsable' ELSE 'UNK' END ) ) AS PNStatus, ITMMASTER.YITM_SUP_0 AS WC, IIF ( SORDERQ.YSOQ_PJTORI_0 = '', SORDERQ.YSOH_PJT_0, SORDERQ.YSOQ_PJTORI_0 ) AS ProjectNO, SORDER.BPCORD_0 AS CustomerCode, SORDER.BPCNAM_0 AS CustomerName FROM EXPLOIT.SORDERQ AS SORDERQ LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDER ON SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 = SORDER.SOHNUM_0 LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ECCSTA AS ECCSTA ON SORDERQ.ITMREF_0 = ECCSTA.ITMREF_0 AND SORDERQ.ECCVALMAJ_0 = ECCSTA.ECCVALMAJ_0 LEFT JOIN EXPLOIT.ITMMASTER AS ITMMASTER ON ITMMASTER.ITMREF_0 = SORDERQ.ITMREF_0 WHERE SORDERQ.SOQSTA_0 != 3 AND ITMMASTER.ITMSTA_0 != 1 AND SORDERQ.SALFCY_0 = #{Site}
